_comment: Pre-declared 2-way shard plan of the full Index DEV for the sharded fulldev_eval modes (jobs.m2_first_cell.fulldev_eval shard-build; DEV rows + RWKV7 row lengths only, never model output). Clusters = harness.cases.case_ids (the bootstrap's cluster unit), never split; initial shard = sha256(seed:case_id) mod N; rebalanced by token count. The job rebuilds it from its rows and refuses on any difference; merge re-checks every hash.
